speaker: john_heminges
text: The afternoon is in. Two Gentlemen, and the yard gone home. We will do what the cloth will hold, and no more.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The gallery, then. By my hose, Saturday is when a man hears a number.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The gallery is not all in. I will not give you a figure the cloth does not hold.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then we have a day, and not a sum. I can live with a day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not in it, John. I had the parlour, and a page. The page is not a share.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody is striking a share. Monday still plays. Errors, and a holiday yard, and you are the old man again. The boxes wait on Monday.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The boxes wait, and my purse waits, and I am to be cheerful about both.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Be cheerful about the street. We stood at the mouth of the close. The Prince of Purpoole rode up to Crosby Place, and the Mayor took him in.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A prince. Marry, and was there dinner?

speaker: richard_burbage
text: For the prince. Mistress Ansell said it beside me. He will dine a play-prince at his table and shut the door on a player.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The Mayor will feast a mock-prince and shut the door on a player. I shall keep that.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Keep it. It will last longer than a gallery that is not all in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She said to mark her, that is the City. Sir John did not speak. He does not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the City is none of this cloth. The Queen's twenty pounds is not in it either. Expected is not a receipt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Expected, and not had, and not mine. I will not have it written on the company's side.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I' faith, you were plainer at the Split Hazel. Fourpence, and Alice looking at it. That I trust.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Fourpence is your dinner. It is not the company's. I am not entering Alice's board on our side.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Nor a glove, nor a hamper. Yesterday was noise. Today is a cloth with a hole in it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt line thine own book at home, and leave John's cloth incomplete. That is the right division.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will line what I paid. The firing, and two boards, and the fourpence. I will not open the coffer to do it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Do not. The count was made when the year came in. I will not have another this week. Monday's Errors may fill a box. It has not filled one yet.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Ask me for patience, then, and not for a sum.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The gallery is not all in. That is the whole of the sentence.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Two dogs on Thursday, and a shut door today. The Queen feeds neither company, and the Mayor feeds a student.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are fed enough to play on Monday. I will sit the middle again, Tom, and I will not ask the parlour to be sorry.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then the reckoning is this. No new share. No figure. A prince dined, and we did not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: That is the reckoning. Go home. The cloth stays here until Monday has played.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The Mayor will feast a mock-prince and shut the door on a player. I have it from this room, and the room had it from the close.
